# android — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 533 android CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/android/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-5383 — Bluetooth implementations may not sufficiently validate elliptic curve parameters during Diffie-Hellman key exchange
- Assigner: certcc | Published: 2018-08-07 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8
- CWE: CWE-325 CWE-325
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 8 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`

Bluetooth firmware or operating system software drivers in macOS versions before 10.13, High Sierra and iOS versions before 11.4, and Android versions before the 2018-06-05 patch may not sufficiently validate elliptic curve parameters used to generate public keys during a Diffie-Hellman key exchange, which may allow a remote attacker to obtain the encryption key used by the device.

Affected:
- Apple / macOS: affected 10.13 High Sierra <10.13.6 (custom)
- Apple / iOS: affected 11 <11.4 (custom)
- Android Open Source Project / Android: affected unspecified <2018-06-05 patch level (custom)

Credits: Lior Neumann and Eli Biham of the Techion Israel Institute of Technology

References:
- http://www.cs.technion.ac.il/~biham/BT/ [x_refsource_MISC]
- http://www.securitytracker.com/id/1041432 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_SECTRACK]

- https://www.bluetooth.com/news/unknown/2018/07/bluetooth-sig-security-update [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/104879 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- https://lists.debian.org/debian-lts-announce/2019/04/msg00005.html [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]

### CVE-2018-6344
- Assigner: facebook | Published: 2018-12-31 | Updated: 2025-05-06 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-122 Heap-based Buffer Overflow (CWE-122)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A heap corruption in WhatsApp can be caused by a malformed RTP packet being sent after a call is established. The vulnerability can be used to cause denial of service. It affects WhatsApp for Android prior to v2.18.293, WhatsApp for iOS prior to v2.18.93, and WhatsApp for Windows Phone prior to v2.18.172.

Affected:
- Facebook / WhatsApp for Android: affected 2.18.293; affected unspecified <2.18.293 (custom)
- Facebook / WhatsApp for iOS: affected 2.18.93; affected unspecified <2.18.93 (custom)
- Facebook / WhatsApp for Windows Phone: affected 2.18.172; affected unspecified <2.18.172 (custom)

References:
- https://googleprojectzero.blogspot.com/2018/12/adventures-in-video-conferencing-part-3.html [x_refsource_MISC]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/106365 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]

- Exploit-DB 50188: Xiaomi browser 10.2.4.g - Browser Search History Disclosure (local/android, 2021-08-10, verified=0)

Xiaomi Stock Browser 10.2.4.g on Xiaomi Redmi Note 5 Pro devices and other Redmi Android phones allows content provider injection. In other words, a third-party application can read the user's cleartext browser history via an app.provider.query content://com.android.browser.searchhistory/searchhistory request.
